prompt:

Visual Style (ch_ledger_doodle): Hand-drawn 2D notebook-ledger explainer illustration: wobbly black marker outlines (#1F1F1F) on a flat warm grid-paper canvas (#FAF6E9 with faint #E3DCC8 square grid), flat unshaded fills in money green (#2F9E5B), coin gold (#F2C14E), loss red (#D64545) and ink navy (#24364F); hand-drawn bar charts, price tags and VND banknotes drawn as simple flat shapes; orthographic 2D, generous empty grid space, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D. Palette: #FAF6E9, #2F9E5B, #F2C14E, #D64545, #24364F.

Character Cast: Simple 2D doodle stickman with a white round head, black dot eyes, thin wire arms and round hands, small round glasses, always holding a pencil or a coin. Outfit: Flat coin-gold (#F2C14E) T-shirt and navy (#24364F) trousers, no folds, no shading.

Scene Composition: The channel character stands centered in the frame, pointing upwards with a welcoming smile. Clean, minimalist composition with at least 60% open negative space on the solid flat background.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text in the upper third integrated directly onto the flat canvas (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "TÚI TIỀN BIẾT NÓI".
